 Starbucks and Pompompurin Team Up for Singapore-Exclusive Collectibles
 Posted by 
 Maybeline 
 Nov 7, 2026 
 Shares 
 READ NEXT 
 Mickey Mouse Turns DJ as Disney On Ice Returns to Singapore With Let’s Dance! in March 2027 
 Something extra sweet is brewing at Starbucks Singapore, and it has everything to do with a certain adorable golden retriever in a brown beret! 
 To celebrate its 30th anniversary, Starbucks Singapore is teaming up with Sanrio’s beloved Pompompurin, who is also turning 30 this year. The result? A Singapore-exclusive collection of limited-edition merchandise, adorable accessories and surprise collectibles that brings together the best of coffee culture and kawaii charm.
 Launching on 10 November 2026, this delightful collaboration is one that Starbucks lovers and Sanrio fans won’t want to miss!
 Starbucks Meets Pompompurin in an Adorable Singapore-Exclusive Collection
 With his floppy ears, signature brown beret and famously laid-back personality, Pompompurin has been winning hearts since his debut in 1996.
 Now, three decades later, the lovable golden retriever is getting a Starbucks-inspired makeover to celebrate a shared milestone with the coffee giant.
 The special collection brings together Pompompurin’s signature charm and playful Starbucks-inspired designs, transforming everyday merchandise and accessories into adorable keepsakes.
 Whether you’re a devoted Sanrio collector, a Starbucks enthusiast or simply someone who can’t resist anything cute, there’s plenty to look forward to.
 And with Christmas just around the corner, these limited-edition goodies might also make the perfect little gifts for friends, family or yourself!
 Don’t Miss the S$9.90 Pompompurin Blind Bags! 
 Alongside the main merchandise collection, Starbucks Singapore is introducing the Pompompurin + Starbucks Phone Lanyard with Charms Blind Bag, available for just S$9.90 with any purchase.
 There are three adorable designs to collect, each featuring Pompompurin paired with a miniature Starbucks beverage-inspired charm.
 Even better, the charms are detachable, allowing you to mix and match them, decorate your phone lanyard or add a little Pompompurin cuteness to your favourite accessories.
 The blind bags will be available at participating Starbucks stores and through the Starbucks Online Store from 10 November 2026, while stocks last.
 Get a FREE Pompompurin x Starbucks Straw Clip Set with Delivery Orders!
 Here’s another adorable treat for Pompompurin fans who prefer enjoying their Starbucks favourites at home!
 From 12 November 2026, receive a FREE Pompompurin + Starbucks Straw Clip Set with a minimum net spend of S$25 on delivery orders through Starbucks Delivers, GrabFood or foodpanda.
 Designed exclusively for this collaboration, the collectible straw clips add an extra dose of cuteness to your favourite Starbucks drinks. And who doesn’t love a free collectible?
 The promotion is available exclusively for delivery orders, with one complimentary set per qualifying transaction, while stocks last.
 The minimum S$25 spend applies after Stars redemptions and vouchers.
 Two 30th Anniversaries, One Extra-Sweet Celebration
 What makes this collaboration even more special is that both Starbucks Singapore and Pompompurin are celebrating their 30th anniversaries in 2026.
 Since opening its first Singapore store in 1996, Starbucks has become a familiar part of the local coffee scene. Meanwhile, Pompompurin has charmed generations of Sanrio fans for the past three decades with his cheerful personality and irresistibly cute appearance.
 Bringing the two together feels like a fitting celebration of nostalgia, friendship and the little everyday moments that make life sweeter.
 From enjoying your favourite Starbucks beverage to adding another adorable collectible to your collection, this collaboration is all about finding joy in the simple things.
 And the best part? The merchandise collection is exclusive to Singapore, making it an especially appealing addition for local fans and collectors.
 Where and When to Shop the Starbucks x Pompompurin Collection in Singapore 
 Mark your calendars! The limited-edition Starbucks x Pompompurin collection officially launches on 10 November 2026.
 Here’s where you can get your hands on the adorable merchandise:
– Starbucks stores islandwide: From 10 November 2026
– Starbucks Online Store : From 10am on 10 November 2026
– Starbucks LazMall: From 12pm on 10 November 2026
 The main merchandise collection is limited to six pieces per item per customer, subject to availability.
 The S$9.90 Pompompurin Phone Lanyard with Charms Blind Bag will be available with any purchase at participating Starbucks stores and through the Starbucks Online Store, with a purchase limit of six pieces per customer. All items are available while stocks last.
 With adorable collectibles and Singapore-exclusive designs, this collaboration is too cute to miss! Mark your calendars and get ready to shop before your favourites sell out!
